show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/NPuwW4
show.description: When a 6-year-old boy sets out to find the perfect father for his single mother, he accidentally walks into the lives of three powerful triplet brothers—one of whom is his real dad, though none remember the night that connects them. One child, one forgotten encounter, and three men tied to a secret that could destroy the entire Mehta empire.
